# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, pull requests, or discussions.

Report them privately through GitHub instead:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/carbondigitalus/mayday-command/security) of this repository.
2. Select **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Fill out the advisory form.

Only you and the maintainers can see the report.

## What to Include

- The affected area (for example, the API, the agent workspace, the customer portal, email processing, or installation and upgrades)
- The Mayday Command version or commit you tested
- Steps to reproduce the issue, or a proof of concept
- The impact you believe the issue has (for example, access to another customer's tickets)

Do not include real customer data, credentials, or ticket content in your report.

## What to Expect

The maintainers will acknowledge your report, and you'll get updates on the advisory while they investigate. Once a fix is ready, the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.

## Supported Versions

Mayday Command is in early development and has no releases yet. After the first release, security fixes will go to the latest release.
